name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> form (domain=run/ui shop flow, descriptor=buy_item_menu). Accurately names the BUY branch top-level loop of the chapter-intro shop menu (sole caller fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_main dispatches cursor==0 here for the buy option). No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Top-level loop for the BUY branch of the chapter-intro shop menu: open the item-grid panel, run the cursor loop, and on commit walk the full buy flow (eligibility filter -> 'buy for whom?' confirm -> affordability -> recipient roster select -> inventory-full check -> add item -> optional auto-equip -> transaction + money-drop animation).
logic_summary: Up front, snapshots four per-shop-tier short[6] dialog text-id tables into locals (no_equip/buy_for/auto_equip/no_money) via memcpy; the inventory-full table is read in place from its global. Then loops forever: restore cursor/scroll from saved globals, open the shop panel, run fd2_shop_menu_input_loop; save cursor/scroll; close panel. Esc (sel==-1) returns. Otherwise read item_id = item_array[saved_cursor], set last_action_sprite_id = item_id+0xB5 (FDTXT item-name base), fetch item_entry via fd2_get_item_effect_entry, store price = *(u16*)(item_entry+0x13). Scan menu party building eligible_chars[]: for gear (item_entry[0] < 0x20) only chars where fd2_check_job_can_equip_item==1 qualify; consumables (>=0x20) make every party member eligible. If gear and no one can equip, show no_equip dialog and continue. Set visible_item_count=candidate_count and candidate_array_ptr=eligible_chars, show 'buy for whom?' yes/no (choice via fd2_text_dialog_typewriter_loop, answer read from cursor_idx; cancel or cursor==1 'no' continues). Signed gold-vs-price test (JGE): if too poor, show no_money and continue. Recipient select: gear uses fd2_party_roster_class_select_loop (stat preview), consumable sets visible_item_count to full party then fd2_party_roster_single_select_loop; restore saved visible_item_count; if not committed (sel!=1) continue. recipient = eligible_chars[cursor_idx]; if inventory full (8 usable slots) show inventory_full and continue. Else fd2_add_item_to_inventory(recipient,item_id); for gear, prompt auto-equip and on 'yes' (choice!=-1 && cursor_idx==0) equip the just-added slot (slot_count-1) and recalc combat stats. Finally play transaction feedback + animate the visible gold decrement by price.

params.name: shop_item_count
params.semantics: Number of items offered in this shop visit. Caller passes fd2_load_chapter_party_roster()&0xff (a misnamed helper that actually returns the active shop tier's item-id count). Forwarded to fd2_open_shop_dialog_panel and fd2_shop_menu_input_loop as the grid item count.
params.reason: Accurate (count of shop items), no address residue.

params.name: shop_item_id_array
params.semantics: Byte array of shop item ids (0x00..0xD6), indexed by the saved cursor to pick the chosen item; caller passes the 12-byte stack buffer filled by fd2_load_chapter_party_roster. Forwarded to the panel open / input-loop calls.

returns.semantics: No return value; the menu loop runs until Esc on the item grid, which returns to the caller (fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_main).
